papers.title: 3D Printing of Silk Fibroin for Biomedical Applications.
papers.abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) printing is regarded as a critical technological-evolution in material engineering, especially for customized biomedicine. However, a big challenge that hinders the 3D printing technique applied in biomedical field is applicable bioink. Silk fibroin (SF) is used as a biomaterial for decades due to its remarkable high machinability and good biocompatibility and biodegradability, which provides a possible alternate of bioink for 3D printing. In this review, we summarize the requirements, characteristics and processabilities of SF bioink, in particular, focusing on the printing possibilities and capabilities of bioink. Further, the current achievements of cell-loading SF based bioinks were comprehensively viewed from their physical properties, chemical components, and bioactivities as well. Finally, the emerging issues and prospects of SF based bioink for 3D printing are given. This review provides a reference for the programmable and multiple processes and the further improvement of silk-based biomaterials fabrication by 3D printing.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是关于丝素蛋白作为生物墨水的综述，未涉及人工智能在生物打印中的应用。
llm.why_not_core: This paper contains no mention of AI, machine learning, or any computational methods integrated into bioprinting; it is a pure materials science review.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述丝素蛋白作为3D打印生物墨水的潜力与挑战。
summary_zh.method: 通过文献调研总结丝素蛋白生物墨水的性能与打印可行性。
summary_zh.result: 概述了当前丝素蛋白载细胞生物墨水的物理、化学及生物特性。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，仅为文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: This review addresses the challenge of identifying suitable bioinks for 3D printing in biomedicine by focusing on silk fibroin.
summary_en.method: The paper summarizes the requirements, characteristics, and processabilities of silk fibroin bioinks through a comprehensive literature review.
summary_en.result: It presents the current achievements in cell-loaded silk fibroin bioinks, covering physical properties, chemical components, and bioactivities.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is provided as this is a review article.
